description: This file contains unit tests for Azure Table Storage data manager CRUD operations and conditional updates, using Xunit framework. It tests creating, reading, updating, deleting, merging, and conditionally inserting/updating table entries with various scenarios.

classes.name: AzureTableDataManagerTests
classes.description: Unit test class for Azure Table Storage data manager CRUD operations and conditional updates.

methods.name: GenerateNewData
methods.description: Generates a new instance of UnitTestAzureTableData with a unique row key.

methods.name: AzureTableDataManagerTests
methods.description: Constructor initializing test setup, including thread pool configuration and table manager.

methods.name: AzureTableDataManager_CreateTableEntryAsync
methods.description: Tests creating a table entry and handling duplicate creation attempts.

methods.name: AzureTableDataManager_UpsertTableEntryAsync
methods.description: Tests upserting (insert or update) a table entry and verifying data.

methods.name: AzureTableDataManager_UpdateTableEntryAsync
methods.description: Tests updating a table entry, handling not found errors, and conditional updates with eTags.

methods.name: AzureTableDataManager_DeleteTableAsync
methods.description: Tests deleting a table entry, handling not found errors, and verifying deletion.

methods.name: AzureTableDataManager_MergeTableAsync
methods.description: Tests merging data into a table entry, handling not found errors, and conditional merge with eTags.

methods.name: AzureTableDataManager_ReadSingleTableEntryAsync
methods.description: Tests reading a single table entry that does not exist yet.

methods.name: AzureTableDataManager_InsertTwoTableEntriesConditionallyAsync
methods.description: Tests conditional insertion of two table entries, handling conflicts and resource not found errors.

methods.name: AzureTableDataManager_UpdateTwoTableEntriesConditionallyAsync
methods.description: Tests conditional update of two table entries, handling resource not found and eTag mismatches.
